Computes per-tract 311 and code-violation counts for 2025, joins to PLACES total population, forms per-1,000-resident rates, keeps only tracts with non-null paired values, and returns the Pearson correlation and paired-tract count over that set, ranked by 311 rate descending.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid AS geoid,
    t.name AS name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.source = 'm1_city' THEN o.value END) AS req_311_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.source = 'm2_city' THEN o.value END) AS violation_count,
    CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_observations o
    ON o.geoid = t.geoid
    AND o.run_id = 'r_20261025_a4a72e'
    AND o.source IN ('m1_city', 'm2_city')
    AND o.geoid IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_a4a72e_population_cdc p
    ON p.tractfips = t.geoid
  GROUP BY t.geoid, t.name, p.totalpopulation
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    name,
    req_311_count,
    violation_count,
    totalpopulation,
    (req_311_count / totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS req_311_per_1000_residents,
    (violation_count / totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS violations_per_1000_residents
  FROM base
  WHERE req_311_count IS NOT NULL
    AND violation_count IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  name,
  req_311_per_1000_residents,
  violations_per_1000_residents,
  req_311_count,
  violation_count,
  totalpopulation,
  CORR(req_311_per_1000_residents, violations_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY req_311_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200

    SUM(CASE WHEN o.source = 'm1_city' THEN o.value END) AS req_311_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.source = 'm2_city' THEN o.value END) AS violation_count,
    CAST(p.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_observations o
    ON o.geoid = t.geoid
    AND o.run_id = 'r_20261025_a4a72e'
    AND o.source IN ('m1_city', 'm2_city')
    AND o.geoid IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_a4a72e_population_cdc p
    ON p.tractfips = t.geoid
  GROUP BY t.geoid, t.name, p.totalpopulation
),
paired AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    name,
    req_311_count,
    violation_count,
    totalpopulation,
    (req_311_count / totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS req_311_per_1000_residents,
    (violation_count / totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS violations_per_1000_residents
  FROM base
  WHERE req_311_count IS NOT NULL
    AND violation_count IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT
  name,
  req_311_per_1000_residents,
  violations_per_1000_residents,
  req_311_count,
  violation_count,
  totalpopulation,
  CORR(req_311_per_1000_residents, violations_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY req_311_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
